$comment: Gzip KB over every emitted client chunk (not just first load). Raised from 625/100 when PostHog (~100 KB, loaded only after analytics consent) and the search/notifications/media/admin routes were added; first-load weight is budgeted by lighthouserc.json (resource-summary:script:size). Total raised 760 -> 840 for @bufbuild/protovalidate (CEL + RE2 engines, ~70 KB gzip), reachable only through a dynamic import() on the first form validation (src/shared/lib/forms/protovalidate-resolver.ts). Total then 840 -> 905: lazy-loading the select filters, the attachment/delete dialogs and the signed-in shell widgets cut first load by up to 90 KB on a route, but every lazy chunk carries its own copy of the shared base-ui popup code (Turbopack does not factor it out), so emitted bytes grow while what a visitor downloads shrinks.
$comment2: modules/shell: first-load gzip JS per route (Next route-bundle-stats), the heaviest route of each module, ~3% above a normal minified build (2026-11-05): tasks 399.6 (/tasks/new), search 353.4, notifications 358.6, locale root 300.5, forbidden 298.5, not-found 159.1 KB (/tasks/[id] 352.5). The drop from the 490/423/423/361/359/240 limits came from three fixes: (1) the tasks pages and loading.tsx import modules/tasks/entries/* instead of the barrel, and the server sections are one file each, so /tasks/[id] no longer carries CreateTaskPage/TaskForm (-26 KB); (2) the Sentry browser SDK is a lazy chunk requested by instrumentation-client.ts through src/app/config/sentry/loader.ts instead of a first-load import (-47 KB on every route, -68 KB on not-found); (3) date-fns locale data loads per active locale (shared/date/format-date.ts) instead of all four in one chunk. Emitted total JS grew ~22 KB (per-locale and lazy chunks), which the total ceiling absorbs. Earlier history: the signed-in layouts import single-export files from modules/<id>/entries/*; the task-list select filters are a ssr:false dynamic chunk; the attachment viewer/delete dialogs load on first click. A module owning no route (auth, media) is covered by the routes that embed it. Next candidate: tasks/new (TaskForm carries the Select stack).
